en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Ismail Al Ju’fy and Moammar Bin Yahya Bin Sam and Muhammad Bin Muslim and Zurara who all said: 
‘We heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘The dissimulation (Taqiyya) is with regards to everything the son of Adamas is compelled to. So Allahazwj has Permitted it for him’.
en.sarwar: 18. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ‘Udhaynah from Isma’il al-Ju’fi and Mu’ammar ibn Yahya ibn Sam and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurara who have said the following: “We heard abu Ja’far (a.s.) saying, ‘
Al-Taqiyyah is whenever the son of Adam is compelled; Allah has made it lawful for him.’”
